summary: Feed s109_single to IDS is degraded due to 27.9% duplicate packets (1014/3631). All other visibility checks (one-way, drops, overload, VLANs, encryption) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Traffic is aggregated from multiple SPAN/mirror sources or dual TAPs without broker deduplication. The same packet is forwarded twice (e.g., ingress + egress SPAN on same VLAN) and delivered to the IDS tool port.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS requires full payload and both directions for stateful inspection. 27.9% duplicates waste ~28% of the 1 Gbps tool capacity, causes incorrect TCP reassembly, duplicate alerts, and reduces effective detection coverage for unique traffic.

recommended_fix.why: Enable packet-broker deduplication with a short time window to drop identical packets before delivery, eliminating duplicates while preserving complete unique traffic for IDS detection.
